description: Requesting an AI summary draft: meeting status, existing draft and queueing.

preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor is its current chair.
The AI server is configured for the meeting sensitivity; no draft exists yet.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an InProgress meeting; actorId: its current chair.
cases.return: Success with the fresh state (MSG384 "Đã gửi yêu cầu. Dự thảo sẽ tự hiện khi AI viết xong."); a Queued draft row is stored with the requester and time.
cases.log: Saved: Queued draft row with requester and request time.

preconditions: Meeting is Ended; actor is its current secretary.
A Failed draft from an earlier request exists.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an Ended meeting with a Failed draft; actorId: its current secretary.
cases.return: Success (MSG384); the draft is Queued again and the old text stays readable until the new one lands.
cases.log: Saved: draft row back to Queued with the new requester and time.

preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor takes part but is neither chair nor secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an InProgress meeting; actorId: an ordinary member.
cases.return: Failure Forbidden (MSG385 "Chỉ Chủ toạ hoặc Thư ký được tạo, sửa và duyệt dự thảo."); nothing is queued.

preconditions: Meeting is still Draft; actor is its current chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Draft meeting; actorId: its current chair.
cases.return: Failure WrongMeetingStatus (MSG386 "Chỉ tạo dự thảo khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra hoặc đã kết thúc."); nothing is queued.

preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor is its current chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Queued draft; actorId: its current chair.
cases.return: Failure Busy (MSG387 "AI đang viết dự thảo, vui lòng chờ."); the waiting draft is untouched.

preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor is its current chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an InProgress meeting; actorId: its current chair.
cases.return: Failure AiUnavailable (MSG394 "Máy AI chưa sẵn sàng. Liên hệ quản trị hệ thống."); nothing is queued, as the request would only fail later.

preconditions: Actor may not read the meeting.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting the actor may not read; actorId: an outsider.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; answered as if the meeting does not exist.

cases.inputs: meetingId: an InProgress meeting; actorId: a deactivated account.

preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor is its current chair.
Two requests arrive at the same time.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an InProgress meeting without a draft; actorId: its current chair, asking twice at once.
cases.return: One request queues the draft (MSG384); the other reads Failure Busy (MSG387).
cases.log: Saved: one Queued draft row; warning logged with the meeting id for the concurrent request.

preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; actor is its current chair.
The store fails while saving the request.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an InProgress meeting; actorId: its current chair.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed (MSG393 "Không lưu được dự thảo. Vui lòng thử lại."); nothing is queued.
cases.log: Error logged with the meeting id.
